subject: Add OpenMultipleConnectionsWithEnter user setting
body:
Add OpenMultipleConnectionsWithEnter user setting

Introduced a new user setting, OpenMultipleConnectionsWithEnter, to control whether pressing Enter opens multiple connections. Updated App.config and Settings.Designer.cs accordingly. Bumped assembly version to 1.78.2.3488. Also updated code generation version comment in Settings.Designer.cs.

triage.rationale: Adds only an unused setting; no handler or options UI consumes it, so the claimed feature has no runtime effect and needs an end-to-end redesign.
